rallyRoute.name: Rally Route
rallyRoute.description: Place start, middle, and end zones. Units in the start circle march through matching offsets at the middle, then the end, fighting along the way.

oilSpill.name: Oil Spill
oilSpill.description: Place two oil circles — outline during deploy; shortly after battle starts oil drips left-to-right onto the path (ward discs stay clear). Connected oil ignites as one field when fire touches it.

sellUnit.name: Sell Pack
sellUnit.description: Click to activate, then click one of your packs to sell it for a supply refund.

moveUnit.name: Move Pack
moveUnit.description: Click to activate, then click one of your packs from an earlier round — it may be dragged and rotated again for the rest of this round.

tutor.name: Field Lesson
tutor.description: Click to activate, then click one of your packs — its XP bar fills to the next level. Buying the level still costs supply.

spawnDwarves.name: Summon Dwarves
spawnDwarves.description: Mark a circle anywhere outside the enemy base. Shortly after battle start, a war band of dwarves bursts from the ground there, one by one — they fight this battle only.

bigMeteor.name: Meteor
bigMeteor.description: Mark a small circle anywhere. Seconds into the battle a meteor obliterates everything there — only ward domes protect (and pay for it).

spawnCrows.name: Summon Crow Riders
spawnCrows.description: Mark a circle anywhere outside the enemy base. Shortly after battle start, crow riders dive in from the sky, one after another — they fight this battle only.

hammerOfGods.name: Hammer of the Gods
hammerOfGods.description: Click to place, move to rotate, click again to lock. A divine hammer drops onto the zone seconds into the battle.

storm.name: Storm Call
storm.description: Mark a wide circle anywhere. Small storm clouds gather high above and hurl lightning at random spots — bolts deal no damage but shock units in a wide splash with a tower-like debuff unless they have golden aura. Ward domes still block the strikes.

meteorShower.name: Meteor Shower
meteorShower.description: Mark a wide circle anywhere. Meteors rain onto random spots inside for a while, each blast burning the ground it hits.

acidSpill.name: Acid Spill
acidSpill.description: Pour an acid capsule like an oil spill — it drips left-to-right onto the ground shortly after battle starts. Ground and air units over the puddle sizzle and turn corroded — taking extra damage from everything.

fireSpill.name: Fire Spill
fireSpill.description: Pour a fire capsule like oil — it drips left-to-right shortly after battle starts and sets the path ablaze (ward discs stay clear). Connected oil ignites with it. Flame lasts this battle only.

dragonAttack.name: Dragon Attack
dragonAttack.description: Draw the dragon’s strafing path (wider and longer than oil). It dives in and breathes fire along the corridor — the beam scorches units as it passes and paints the ground ablaze. Ward domes absorb the breath (and pay for it).

poisonCloud.name: Poison Cloud
poisonCloud.description: Mark a huge circle. Toxic clouds gather overhead and rain small acid drops across the area — sparse puddles that corrode ground and air units like Acid Spill, but over a much wider field.
